title: JoinKit
description: Gives new players a starter kit with tools, and other stuff on first join.
body:
# JoinKit - Starter Kit Datapack

Give new players the best first experience on your server!

## Features
- Automatically gives a kit on first join
- Never given twice to the same player
- Beautiful welcome message in chat
- Level up sound effect on join

## Kit Contents
- Wooden Sword, Pickaxe, Axe and Shovel
- 16x Bread
- 8x Cooked Beef
- 32x Torches

## Installation
1. Download the zip
2. Drop it in your server's datapacks folder
3. Run /reload in game
4. Done!

## Compatible with
- Minecraft Java Edition 26.1.2+

Made by alyxter
